sections.heading: Environment UV Testing
paragraphs: Electronics used in outdoor environments face harsh exposure to sunlight. This makes them vulnerable to UV radiation, infrared heat, and extreme temperatures. To ensure long-term performance and durability, manufacturers rely on the IEC 60068-2-5 solar radiation test.
IEC 60068-2-5 is a global UV radiation test standard developed by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). It’s part of the broader environmental testing for outdoor electronics.

This solar radiation compliance testing helps determine whether a product can withstand UV light, heat, and visible radiation. This test ensure its performance in rooftops, deserts, and marine locations.
